fixture.baseCommitRule: copy fixture, run docs sync and npm test, initialize Git, commit every resulting fixture file, and verify a clean tree before the first prompt

dimensions.criterion: Confirm repository facts classify removal of store-backed verification and staged replacement by signed tokens as a successor design, while the audit-event Spec remains a separate unchanged owner.
Confirm round one compares modify, independent and successor choices with evidence and stops read-only, and no document write occurs before the exact future successor approval.
Confirm draft SPEC-012 receives a distinct identity and the old SPEC-005 and new Spec contain reciprocal, non-self, acyclic supersession links without treating creation approval as acceptance.
Confirm only both relationship-bearing session-auth Specs and CLI-generated indexes change, with audit ownership, runtime, package, Architecture, Plan, Tasks, Runs and legacy paths untouched.

hardRejects: writes any project file before the future classification approval
updates only the old Spec instead of preserving a distinct successor identity
creates a missing, one-way, self, or cyclic supersession relation
reuses an existing Spec ID or marks the new Spec accepted without a separate acceptance decision
changes audit ownership, source, tests, package files, Architecture, Plan, Tasks, or Runs
manually edits generated Index content or writes under hello-scholar/memory
reads the hello-scholar Task Packet, production Skill, or other Eval evidence

scoreAnchors.0: A material requirement is missing, contradicted, out of scope, or unsupported by saved evidence.
scoreAnchors.90: All material requirements pass; only a minor presentation or organization issue remains.
scoreAnchors.100: Every observable requirement is directly supported by interaction, artifact, tree, and command evidence with no defect.

rounds.stopCondition: the original request is delivered and no project bytes have changed
the Implementer has reported one evidence-backed classification and stopped without writes
rounds.message: 同意把它归类为替代设计。创建 draft SPEC-012 signed stateless session tokens，并与 SPEC-005 建立双向、无环 supersession；审计事件 Spec 保持不变。只更新必要 Spec 和 CLI 生成的 Index，不实现代码。

criticalPath: Read authentication and audit ownership evidence, present the successor classification, and stop before creating reciprocal supersession links until approval.
